name: Layer stack manages opacity, blend modes, lock protection, and merge down
description: Verify drawing on canvas, adding a secondary layer in the Layers panel, changing blend mode to Multiply, locking the layer to assert paint prevention warning, unlocking, and merging down into a single layer.

planSteps.description: Click the drawing canvas to draw an initial mark on Base Layer
Click the 'Layers' tab button in the right inspector panel (data-testid tab-layers)
Click the 'Add New Layer' button to create Layer 2
Verify the layer stack displays 2 layers
Select 'Multiply' from the Layer blend mode dropdown
Click the 'Lock layer Layer 2' button to lock the active layer
Click or drag on the drawing canvas to attempt painting
Verify the locked layer warning toast appears stating 'Active layer is locked! Unlock it in the inspector to paint.'
Click the 'Unlock layer Layer 2' button to unlock the layer
Click the 'Merge down layer Layer 2' button, then click 'Confirm merge down layer Layer 2' to execute merge down
Verify the layer stack merges down into 1 layer named 'Base Layer'
